transcript.text:
Ah, Mitsuri-chan, come in, come in. Have a seat here, please. I've had a look at your recent reports and... well, I have some news, though it's not entirely clear yet. Your current symptoms, the fatigue you mentioned and the odd aches... they don't quite match any demon-exposure pattern I've seen in all my years.

However, something is definitely amiss with your muscle strength. It's unusual, quite unusual, for someone with your unique physiology. To understand what's truly happening, I'll need to run a series of further examinations. This will, unfortunately, mean taking you off active duty for at least two weeks, perhaps more. I cannot yet say whether this is serious, but we need to find out.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your time, sensei. I understand the need for further examinations. While I'm... well, not exactly comfortable with the idea of being taken off duty, I know that being in peak condition is vital for our work. I trust your judgment and will do whatever is necessary to get to the bottom of this. What kind of tests will we be doing?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Thank you, Mitsuri-chan. Your understanding is greatly appreciated, truly. And I assure you, we will do everything we can to get you back to peak condition.

As for the tests, they'll be a bit varied. We'll start with some more detailed blood work – not just for demon residue, but looking for other markers of inflammation or unusual cellular activity. Then, we'll need to do some more focused physical assessments, examining your muscle response and nerve function with more specialized tools than our usual check-ups. It might involve a few small electrical impulses to test nerve conductivity, and some specific exercises to gauge muscle endurance in a controlled environment. Nothing too painful, I promise, but it will be thorough. We need to rule out every possibility, and then pinpoint the cause.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see. It all sounds... rather thorough, and I appreciate your reassurance about the level of discomfort. I'll do my best to remain still and cooperative throughout the process. I want to help you help me, after all. Will I be able to assist with any of the tests, or is it best that I just remain passive during them? And... I'm sorry for the sudden shift in subject, but do you have any idea how long the entire process might take? I'm trying to plan accordingly, and... well, I'm rather unused to not knowing when I'll be back in the field.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
That's a very good question, Mitsuri-chan, and your cooperation will be invaluable. For some of the physical assessments, like testing muscle endurance, we'll need your active participation – following instructions to push or pull against resistance, for example. For others, particularly the blood work and certain neurological checks, you'll need to remain still and allow us to do our work. I'll guide you through each step, so you'll know exactly what to do, or not do, at the right time.

Regarding the timeline... the initial phase of tests, which will take you off active duty, will likely span those first two weeks. During that time, we'll collect all the necessary data. Once we have those results, we'll analyze them. *Then*, depending on what we discover, we'll either have a clear path to treatment, or we might need further specialized tests, which could extend the period.

I understand completely that not knowing is difficult, especially for someone as dedicated as you. But your health is paramount. We need to ensure you're fully recovered and strong before you return to the field. Please, try not to worry too much about the time away; focus on resting and allowing us to work. We'll keep you informed every step of the way.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see. Thank you for explaining everything so clearly, sensei. I... I may not be able to help but worry a bit, but I'll do my best to focus on the process and not the uncertainty. I'll do whatever I can to assist with the tests, and I'll try to be patient with the time it takes. It's not easy to be away from the front lines, but I understand that it's for the best. If there's anything I can do to speed up the process, please let me know. I want to get back to being able to do my part as soon as I can.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Your dedication is truly admirable, Mitsuri-chan, and exactly why we need you at your best. Please don't apologize for worrying; it's a natural response, especially given your role and how much you care. Just try to channel that dedication into following our instructions and focusing on your rest.

The best thing you can do to "speed up the process," from your end, is to conserve your energy and allow your body to be as receptive as possible to the examinations. Resting well, eating the nutritious meals provided, and minimizing any strenuous activity will ensure the most accurate readings during the tests. We need to see your body's true state, unmasked by further exertion. Think of it as a vital part of your contribution right now.

We'll begin with the initial blood work first thing in the morning. Just make sure you're well-rested tonight. We'll find out what's going on, Mitsuri-chan.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, sensei. I will do my best to rest well tonight and be prepared for the tests in the morning. I appreciate your guidance, and I'm glad to know that you and the team will be closely monitoring my condition. It's... it's reassuring to have you all working on this, even if I can't be out there on the front lines. I'll do my part here, in the healing quarters, to the best of my ability. Thank you for taking care of me in this way.

You are most welcome, Mitsuri-chan. It is our duty and our honor to take care of you, just as you take care of so many others on the front lines. Seeing to your well-being is every bit as crucial as any battle fought against a demon. Your "part" here, in the healing quarters, is to heal, and that is a task you must approach with the same dedication you bring to your blade.

Rest tonight. We will be here to guide you through everything starting tomorrow. We'll work together to understand what's happening and get you back on your feet, fully strong again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I'll do my best to follow your advice, sensei. I promise to rest well tonight and be ready for whatever comes tomorrow. Your words... they mean a lot to me. Good night. Rest well. We will see you bright and early.
